capabilities.text: Choose a zero-, first- or second-order reaction
Type the starting concentration [A]₀ and the rate constant k
capabilities.note: also drag handles on [A]₀ and the first half-life

capabilities.text: Keep the first half-life the same when the order changes
Draw [A], ln[A] and 1/[A] against time side by side
Draw any one of [A], ln[A] or 1/[A] against time on its own
capabilities.note: ours draws [A], or the one straight-line plot for the chosen order (ln[A] for first, 1/[A] for second), not any of the three

capabilities.text: Draw the curve, 5 to 10 data points, or both
Scatter the data points by about 1, 2 or 5%, or not at all
Draw a fresh set of scattered data
Put a data table under the graphs: time and [A], or with ln[A] and 1/[A] too
Copy the data for a spreadsheet
Draw dashed guides at the first 1, 2 or 3 half-lives on the [A] graph
capabilities.note: ours turns half-life markers on or off; always three

capabilities.text: Label the half-life guides with their times, as half-lives, with blank lines, or not at all
capabilities.note: ours always writes both the times and [A]₀/2, [A]₀/4…

capabilities.text: Name the reactant, by name or formula
Write concentrations in M, mol/L or mol dm⁻³
Measure time in seconds, minutes or hours
Number the axes, or draw sketch graphs without numbers
Turn the gridlines on or off
Draw in color or in black and white
Give the chart a title as text, a blank line, or none
Give each axis title as text, a blank line, or none
Choose the label size
